name: y-exa
description: Single-source MCP plugin that adds the Exa semantic-web-search server (npx exa-mcp-server), giving agents full-text web search and content retrieval. Lets any bundle depend on one shared definition instead of redeclaring the server (avoids the Claude Code MCP-name dedupe warning). Prompts for an Exa API key on enable via userConfig; get one at https://exa.ai/.

exa_api_key.title: Exa API key
exa_api_key.description: API key for Exa semantic web search. Get one at https://exa.ai/ -> dashboard -> API keys.
